title: Set up Tawdheef
description: Download the app and let Codex or Claude Code handle local setup while you complete your sign-ins.

title: Connect Codex or Claude Code
description: Connect the local tracker tools, install the workflow skill and verify the assistant you want Run to use.

title: Create or connect your CV
description: Create a free digital CV on Tabbio or connect your existing account, then check that Tawdheef can read it.

title: Use the Tawdheef skill
description: Install the optional workflow guidance and give your agent practical requests for shortlists, applications and reply checks.

title: Add a country directory
description: Download a free country pack from GitHub, extract it and import every CSV part into your chosen tab.

title: Start your first application run
description: Choose companies, describe the work you want and let your assistant carry out the actions you select.

title: Check replies and reports
description: Review tracked replies, save a local report and choose optional schedules without starting new applications.

title: Fix a setup or run problem
description: Find the next fix for startup, assistant sign-in, CV reads, browser tools, email setup or incomplete pack imports.

title: Use Tawdheef as an agent
description: Read the local tool contract, discover public packs and record actual outcomes within the requested scope.
